title: CRJ900 American Eagle & Singapore A310! NEW MSFS 2020 Marketplace Activities
description:
Ready to take on regional jet rotations, fly classic widebody routes across Southeast Asia, or inject authentic airline schedules into Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020? The Marketplace just rolled out a fresh wave of flight activities headlined by regional CRJ900 rotations, an A310 Singapore Airlines route package, global fleet and hub traffic overhauls from VA Systems, and scenic tours highlighting World Update 23: Poland and the Baltics.

In this marketplace breakdown, we skip the storefront clutter and organize these arrivals into clear categories—highlighting key aircraft compatibility requirements and prerequisite warnings so you can plan your next flight without surprises:

✈️ COMMERCIAL AIRLINE ROTATIONS & WIDEBODY CAPTAINCY (PERFECT FLIGHT)
Take command of pre-briefed airline legs with authentic soundscapes and simulated in-flight events:

- 12 Legs – CRJ900 EGF Fall 2026: Fly a comprehensive North American regional route network across US hubs in the American Eagle livery. Features pre-calculated flight levels, standard airway routing, SID/STAR procedures, and custom audio integration. (⚠️ Prerequisite: Requires the third-party Aerosoft CRJ base aircraft).
- A310 Captain – Singapore Airlines: Step into the flight deck of the classic twin-aisle Airbus for 8 scheduled IFR operations connecting Singapore Changi (WSSS) to high-altitude regional hubs including Jakarta (WIII), Bali (WADD), Bangkok Suvarnabhumi (VTBS), and Penang (WMKP). Includes two classic Singapore Airlines schemes. (⚠️ Prerequisite: Requires the iniBuilds A310-300).

🌐 AIRLINE FLEET SCHEDULES & GLOBAL HUB TRAFFIC (VA SYSTEMS)
Eliminate empty skies and inject real-world Summer 2026 airline schedules directly into your flight log:

- Summer 2026 Fleet Schedules: Dedicated route packages and airline liveries covering real-world operations for BA CityFlyer, Air Astana, SpiceJet, and SkyWest Airlines. (Requires owning the respective aircraft models to fly all assigned legs).
- International Hub Traffic Overhauls: Regional traffic injections bringing true-to-life scheduled commercial variety to major international hubs, including Casablanca Mohammed V (GMMN), Charlotte Douglas (KCLT), Lisbon Humberto Delgado (LPPT), Quito Mariscal Sucre (SEQM), and New Delhi Indira Gandhi (VIDP).

🏔️ EASTERN EUROPEAN & BALTIC EXCURSIONS (WORLD UPDATE 23 COMPATIBLE)
Discover newly enhanced European landscapes, castles, and mountain peaks:

- Baltic and Poland Discovery Tour: A 12-leg expedition designed to showcase the refreshed scenery from free World Update 23: Poland and the Baltics. Optimized with dual aircraft profiles for the Pilatus PC-6 B2-H4 Turbo Porter (G950) or the Antonov An-28, featuring custom audio commentary, ATC integration, and complete flight documentation.
- Poland and the Baltics (Parts 1 & 2): Fly low and slow in the Cub across Silesia, the High Tatras, and historic cities toward Warsaw. (Note: These packages provide the route structure and narration; they leverage free World Update 23 scenery).

Whether you're managing complex regional jet approaches, taking a heavy Airbus across the equator, or exploring the High Tatras, these additions bring structured flight planning back to your simulator.

Which of these activity packs or schedule overhauls are you loading up first? Drop your pick in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2020 additions, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
